name: Paris IdFM Trains Pack
author: Haeffound
description:
Contains various Paris-region rolling stock:
- Metro on rail: MF 01, MF 19
- Metro on rubber tyres: MP 89, MP 14
- Grand Paris Express: MR3V, MR6V
- RER: MI 09, MI 84, MI 20, Z 2N, RER NG
- Transilien: NAT, Francilien
- Tram-trains: Dualis
- Trams: Citadis
- Airport APM: VAL

This mod use the beta feature to allow some trains to run on others tracks. See Vehicle description to see what is compatible with what.
